b) Control Plane:
- Represent the daemon component (`cmd/uncloudd`)

- Show the configuration management system

c) Machine Layer:
- Docker host management
- Network management (WireGuard)

- Storage management

d) Communication Layer:
- gRPC API services (visible in `internal/machine/api/pb`)
- Network tunneling
- SSH connectivity

Draw the diagram with these flows:
```
[Client CLI] → [Control Plane Daemon] → [Machine Layer]
                      ↓
              [Network Mesh Layer]
```

- Draw a central "Daemon Controller" box
- Include subcomponents:

  * Service Orchestrator

b) Machine Layer Components:
- Docker Engine integration
- Network management (WireGuard)
- Container runtime
- Storage subsystem

c) Network Mesh:
- WireGuard overlay network
- Service discovery
- Load balancing

- Gray: External dependencies (Docker)

- gRPC API endpoints

- Docker API integration
